criteria.requirement: Fix _Error.json_path dot-safe identification with full-string matching and correct single-quoted bracket escaping for quote/backslash and every C0 control character. A key x followed by LF must never render as $.x plus a raw LF or resolve to the separate key x. Preserve ordinary ASCII identifier dot notation, Unicode/empty bracket keys, array indexes, original path values and absolute parent-path composition. Demonstrate independent decoding/selection round trips rather than only comparing a hard-coded diagnostic string.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
